name: explain_card
description: Explain what a detected handheld SD card is and what the user should do next. Use it when asked to explain a card state or a refused operation. Do not use it for anything else.

observation.description: One or two sentences describing what is on the card, drawn from the supplied CardFacts

next_step.description: The single most useful next action for the user: a button label or short instruction

suggested_profile_id.description: The shipped Card Studio profile matching this card, or bear none for arkos-roms-card when unsure
